errors.evidence: The description states the overall period is from 1995 to 2018, but the earliest category on the chart is "1990-1995", so the period starts in 1990.

errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос съдържа категории, които представят различните периоди на стартиране на дейността
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the axes. The horizontal axis represents the percentage scale, while the vertical axis contains the categories (time periods).
The description lists a category "1995-2001", which does not exist in the chart. The chart has categories "1990-1995" and "1996-2001".
The description uses the term "височината" (height) for a horizontal bar chart. The correct term should be "дължината" (length) of the bars.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са подредени по низходящ ред
errors.evidence: The bars are not sorted in descending order of their values. They are ordered chronologically by the time period on the vertical axis, from bottom to top.

errors.text_span: най-високият стълб съответства на периода 2013-2018 г., последван от 1995-2001, 2002-2007, 2008-2012 и най-ниският стълб съответства на 2013-2018 г.
errors.evidence: This sentence is contradictory and nonsensical. It states that the tallest bar corresponds to 2013-2018 and then, in the same sentence, that the shortest bar also corresponds to 2013-2018.
